End-to-end verification of Phase 2:

1. zetl theme install <github-shorthand> installs theme from GitHub.
2. zetl theme install <url>#<tag> installs at specific version.
3. zetl theme install <url> --path <subdir> extracts correct subdirectory.
4. zetl theme install with --name overrides theme name.
5. Duplicate install without --force fails
6. .zetl-source.toml written with correct provenance.
7. zetl theme list shows the installed theme with origin.
8. zetl serve --theme <installed> renders correctly.
9. zetl theme remove <installed> deletes theme.
10. zetl theme remove default fails (bundled).
11. Invalid source strings produce clear errors.
12. Path traversal attempts rejected.
13. Missing git on PATH produces helpful error.
14. cargo test passes.

TEST-014-006 through TEST-014-013, TEST-014-015, TEST-014-016.
